worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.summary: Lay a bath of charged particles on a chosen patch of ground: while inside it, anyone's Normal-type moves become Electric. It affects both sides, so where you lay it is the real choice.
Choose ground within %1$s blocks and lay a bath of radius %2$s blocks lasting %3$s s; anyone inside with line of sight to its centre carries an ion film, and their Normal-type moves become Electric. The bath stays where it is laid and ends automatically if its centre gets more than 48 blocks from you.

After leaving the bath the ion film lingers about %1$s ticks, and Normal-type moves still become Electric while it lasts. The bath treats both sides the same: it can empower you or turn an enemy's Normal move Electric (blocked by Ground or absorbed by Electric-absorbing abilities).
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.wide.0: Wide bath: radius x1.3, but duration -30% and cooldown +0.6 s, made to reshape a front fast.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.wide.1: Lasting bath: radius x0.85, but duration +40% and cooldown -0.6 s, made to hold a small patch.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks. After %2$s s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to lay the bath, recovers %3$s s, and commits a %5$s s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.preference.w: On = wide: radius x1.3, but duration -30% and cooldown +0.6 s. Off = lasting: radius x0.85, but duration +40% and cooldown -0.6 s. Coverage and lifetime trade off.
worldcombat.skill.iondeluge.preference.a: The companion only lays a bath while a threat is within this distance; lower lays up close, higher sets it up in advance.
"Toward the threat" places the bath between you and the threat; "Under yourself" places it at your feet.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lay a bath.
